prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
ai_overview_text:
The best online courses for shadow work and spiritual practice combine depth psychology (such as Carl Jung’s work) with somatic or contemplative traditions: Sounds True +2
Course NamePlatform / TeacherFormat & DurationCost / PricePrimary FocusEncounters with the ShadowJung Platform (James Hollis)4 classes, 4 hours video/audio$127Jungian shadow formation, projection, and individuationEmbracing The ShadowAwake Academy (Charlie Morley)7-week guided coursePaid (Platform enrollment)Tibetan Buddhism, mindfulness, and shadow integrationShadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow SelfUdemy (Melanie Stevens)16 sections, 48 lectures (~2 hours)Variable (Udemy pricing)Beginners, chakra care, triggers, and journalingInto The Light: A Journey Through Shadow WorkInsight Timer (Course format)Multi-day guided audio/textApp / Course access tierTriggers, projections, and foundational shadow principlesHunt Your Own ShadowZachary PhillipsFree 12-week self-paced courseFreeMindfulness, inner child work, and self-inquiry
Encounters with the Shadow (Jung Platform): Led by Jungian analyst James Hollis, this short program breaks down how the unconscious shadow forms through early adaptation, relationship projections, and behavioral patterns. It is ideal if you want a rigorous psychological foundation. Jung Platform
Embracing The Shadow (Awake Academy): Taught by Charlie Morley, this 7-week journey merges Tibetan Buddhist spiritual practices with modern insight training and Western psychology. It includes dream work, shamanic mask practices, and guided meditations. www.awakeacademy.org
Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self (Udemy): Taught by Reiki master Melanie Stevens, this course is tailored for beginners and spiritual seekers. It covers heart chakra care, identifying emotional triggers, and practical journaling prompts. Udemy
Into The Light (Insight Timer): A gentle, accessible audio-guided course focusing on recognizing emotional triggers as doorways to old wounds and using projections as mirrors for self-discovery. Insight Timer
Hunt Your Own Shadow: A free, 12-week self-paced program by Zachary Phillips that uses journaling, contemplation, and inner child work to help process unresolved patterns.
Are you looking for a free self-paced option, a therapeutically focused Jungian course, or something that blends meditation and energy work?
